title: API keys
description: Secret keys for connecting to the MangaBox API. Keep them server-side and never share them with anyone.

errors.createFailed: Something went wrong while creating the key.

empty.title: No API keys yet
empty.description: Create your first key and connect your integration.

deleteDialog.title: Delete this key?
deleteDialog.description: will be permanently deleted. This action cannot be undone, and any integrations using this key will stop working.

created.title: Save your key
created.description: This key is shown only once. Copy it now and store it somewhere safe.

form.title: New API key
form.description: Create a key for your integrations and choose the permissions it needs.

name.label: Name
name.hint: An internal name to help you recognize the key later. For example: “Production server” or “Test environment”.

scopes.label: Scopes
scopes.hint: Defines which actions the key can perform. Grant only the permissions you need — it's safer that way.

expiry.label: Expiry
expiry.hint: The key is automatically revoked after the selected number of days. “Never expires” means no limit.
